description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 26.07.2021 to 01.08.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and rescinds a previous notification. This content falls under the establishment or modification of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for customs operations, which is characteristic of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
